Timeheld Website Privacy Notice

Version
1.0
Effective date
October 31, 2026
Covers
Visits to the timeheld.app website and emails sent to support@timeheld.app

1. Who we are

The timeheld.app website is operated by Jan Kazimierczak ("Timeheld", "we", "us"). We are responsible for (the "controller" of) the personal information described here. Contact: support@timeheld.app.

This notice covers only the website and emails to our support address. If you test the Timeheld private beta, the Timeheld Beta Privacy Policy at timeheld.app/privacy explains how the beta app handles your information.

2. What happens when you visit

The website is hosted on Cloudflare. To deliver pages to you and protect the site from abuse, Cloudflare processes the technical information your browser sends with every request, such as your IP address, browser and device type, the page you asked for and the time of the request. We do not use this information to identify you.

The website does not set cookies, use analytics or advertising tools, track you across sites, show third-party content or ask you to fill in any forms. Its fonts and images come from our own site, so your browser does not contact other companies while you browse it. We have not turned on visitor logging for the website. Cloudflare shows us aggregated statistics, such as the number of requests and the countries they come from, which do not identify you. Cloudflare may keep its own security and operational logs under its own terms. If a page fails to load, your browser may send Cloudflare a short network error report, which can include your IP address.

The site links to our Instagram page. If you follow that link, you leave our website and Instagram's privacy policy applies.

3. When you email us

Email sent to support@timeheld.app is forwarded by Cloudflare to our Gmail inbox (Google). We receive your email address, your name if your email includes it, and whatever you write or attach. We use it only to answer you and to deal with what you asked about. We keep support emails for as long as needed to answer you, and then delete them within 12 months.

4. Our legal basis (EU)

If you live in the EU, we rely on our legitimate interests (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f)) in running a secure website and answering the messages we receive. Where your email is about joining or using the beta, we also rely on taking steps you have asked for (Art. 6(1)(b)). In Canada, we rely on your implied consent when you visit the site or email us; you can withdraw it at any time (section 6).

5. Who we share it with and where it goes

Only our service providers Cloudflare (website hosting and email forwarding) and Google (Gmail), plus authorities if the law requires it. We do not sell or rent your information. We are based in Canada. Cloudflare and Google may process information in other countries under their own terms and safeguards. The European Commission recognises Canada as providing adequate protection for personal information handled by organisations subject to Canada's federal private-sector privacy law (PIPEDA) in the course of commercial activities.

6. Your rights

You can ask us to access, correct or delete your information, to receive a copy, and to withdraw your consent. If you live in the EU, you can also restrict or object to our use of it. Email support@timeheld.app. We respond without undue delay and within the legal deadline: for EU requests, generally one month (where the law allows an extension, we explain why within that month), and for Canadian requests, 30 days. Because we have not turned on visitor logging, we usually hold no information about a visit that we could link to you.

If you are not satisfied, you can complain to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada (priv.gc.ca) or, in the EU, to the data protection supervisory authority where you live.

7. Changes and contact

The website is not intended for children. If we change how the website handles information, for example by adding analytics or cookies, we will update this notice before the change takes effect and change the effective date. Questions: support@timeheld.app.
